cohort: 75 deliveries to 67 HIV-positive women in Singapore
finding: The vertical transmission rate of HIV was 5.3% in this cohort; there was no difference in perinatal transmission in women with very low viral load irrespective of the mode of delivery
mod_finding: Of 12 women with viral load <50 copies/mL, 4 had a vaginal birth and 8 had a cesarean section; all babies were HIV-negative.
